blocks.UBASE_00: 20x20 two-level alien base command centre surrounded by earth. Lower level: purple-floored room walled with amber pod panels, red pods and lanterns, a 3x3 lift in the middle, cave rock outside; upper level: bridge with four 2x2 command consoles and chairs around the lift.
blocks.UBASE_01: 20x20 alien garden cave: dark rock floor and rock walls on both levels, densely planted with red twig plants, trumpet fungi, purple pods and green ground cover; irregular open paths, solid earth at the edges.
blocks.UBASE_02: 20x20 alien store room: one big pale-floored room lined with panel walls, a grid of specimen cases and six 2x2 storage tanks (yellow, green, blue), with a small windowed lift room with doors in the middle.
blocks.UBASE_03: 20x20 stores block. Lower level: corridor ringing a solid earth core with a lift; upper level: several panel-walled rooms with storage tanks, drums, lanterns, red pods and two UFO power sources (elerium stored here).
blocks.UBASE_04: 10x10 hydroponics room: lower level plain floor, upper level glowing green floor, panel walls on the north/west sides, lift in the north corner.
blocks.UBASE_05: 10x10 room: upper level holds eight specimen cases around a central red pad; lower level is an open room with a small walled lift booth.
blocks.UBASE_06: 10x10 junction: upper level a U-shaped corridor around earth with red lift pads; lower level four small rooms with doors and lifts arranged around an earth core.
blocks.UBASE_07: 10x10: upper level solid earth; lower level a cross-shaped corridor (four-way junction) with panel walls.
blocks.UBASE_08: 10x10: upper level earth with a small pit room of four specimen cases; lower level a walled room with an inner lift room and door.
blocks.UBASE_09: 10x10 small alien garden: rock floor, rock walls on the back edges, green ground cover with a clump of fungi and purple pods in the middle.
blocks.UBASE_10: 10x10: upper level solid earth; lower level a cross-shaped room with four red pods on legs.
blocks.UBASE_11: 10x10 room with amber and blue pod-panel walls along the north and west edges and a glowing purple floor, open to the south/east.
blocks.UBASE_12: 10x10 partitioned room: a central UFO power source, short panel-wall partitions forming alcoves, red pods in the alcoves; same layout on both levels.
blocks.UBASE_13: 10x10 room with four red pods around a floor pad in the centre and specimen cases against the walls.
blocks.UBASE_14: 10x10 dense alien garden: rock floor packed with purple pods, trumpet fungi and red twig plants, little open ground.
blocks.UBASE_15: 20x20 brain room. Lower level: corridors around earth with two lifts; upper level: a cave with plants, the 2x2 alien brain on the west side facing rows of alien chairs, two command consoles, storage tanks, orb lamps and a pale walkway with lift pads.
blocks.UFO1A: Small scout: a 3x3 saucer on four landing legs (hull one level up) with a single lift in the centre; no real interior.
blocks.UFO_110: Medium scout (10x10, one storey): one rectangular room entered by a hull door on the south side, power source in the middle, chairs and wall consoles/screens on the west side.
blocks.UFO_120: Large scout (20x20, one storey): cross-shaped hull, door in the south arm, a central walled room with the power source, navigation corner with consoles in the north-west.
blocks.UFO_130: Harvester (20x20 octagon, three storeys): lower deck with dissection room (cow on the table, specimen tubes), storage and power sources; lifts up to a middle deck and a bridge with two 2x2 consoles and chairs on top.
blocks.UFO_140: Abductor (20x20, two storeys): stepped octagon with arms; lower deck has the operating room (purple tables, glyph walls) in the centre and power sources in side rooms; upper deck bridge with consoles and chairs.
blocks.UFO_150: Terror ship (30x20, two storeys): octagonal core with an inner ring room holding four power sources around a lift, two side arms with red pods.
blocks.UFO_160: Battleship (30x30, three storeys): on the ground four separate octagonal pods around a central lift, each with a power source and lift, joined into one huge octagon deck above with many rooms, pods and consoles.
blocks.UFO_170: Supply ship (30x20, three storeys): two linked octagons with corridors, lifts, power sources and glyph doors; storage/dissection gear on upper decks.

notes: Map z=0 is the LOWEST level (parseMap reads top-first). Alien base blocks are two levels deep and everything that isn't a room is filled with solid-earth (U_BASE 60) objects. Lifts = alien-lift floor on every level of the shaft plus lift-beams object on the lowest tile. Chair names come from their placement around the 2x2 command console in UBASE_00/UFO_130 (W28 north side, W27 west, W30 east, W29 south); the facing itself is inferred. U_WALL02 33/34 are west-wall-only consoles. U_BASE 22-25 (pink brain-coral cube faces) are used in no map, so skipped (probably a 2x2 object, arrangement unknown). UFO1 records 8 and 11-15 only appear in the odd 2x2 UFO1B block; skipped. U_BITS floor-edge pieces and U_EXT02 hull diagonals' exact facings are approximate (named generically). UFO block descriptions come from renders + object dumps; room purposes for 150/160/170 partly guessed.
